how_to_apply: Send the application in the prescribed format in a sealed cover superscribed 'Application for Retainer Doctor' to the Deputy General Manager at the ERPL Mughalsarai address.
Attach copies of medical qualification certificate, experience certificates and registration certificate, and a self-attested passport size colour photograph.
Send within 14 days of publication of the advertisement.
Make sure it reaches by 20 November 2026.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for IOCL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 20 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How do I apply for IOCL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form (Prescribed format attached on page 3 of the notice) and send it to Deputy General Manager, Indian Oil Corporation Limited (Pipelines Division), ERPL Mughalsarai, Indian Oil Corporation Limited, Eastern Region Pipelines (Pipelines Division), P.O.- Alinagar, Mughalsarai, Chandauli - 232101, by sealed cover superscribed 'application for retainer doctor', to reach by 20 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the salary for IOCL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: MD/MS: Rs 1530 per hour, maximum Rs 39,780 per month; MBBS: Rs 1190 per hour, maximum Rs 30,940 per month.

faq.question: Q4. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: MD (Medicine) / MS (General Surgery) / MBBS with minimum 2 years' experience as General Practitioner; MD/MS preferred over MBBS.

faq.question: Q5. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Part-time Doctor-in-attendance on retainership basis: 2 hours per day for maximum 13 days per month.

faq.question: Q6. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Contract period 3 years, may be extended further for 2 years depending upon requirement and performance. 5% annual increase on cumulative basis for the next three years or till next revision. Remuneration paid on actual attendance basis.

faq.question: Q7. Where is the posting for this recruitment?
Q8. Which documents are needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Copy of Certificate of Medical Qualification; Copy of Experience Certificates from previous employers; Copy of Certificate of Registration (valid on date of submission of application); Latest self-attested passport size colour photograph.
